about: The one site table, read by backend app/core/sites.py and frontend src/lib/sites.ts. The two copies (backend app/core/sites.json, frontend src/lib/sites.json) must stay byte-identical: backend tests/services/test_sites.py fails when they differ.

Every lookup goes by site key: upper case, with every character other than A-Z and 0-9 dropped. 'W-202', 'w 202' and 'W202' are one spelling, so aliases lists only the spellings that differ by more than case, spaces or punctuation. No key may belong to two sites.

canonical: the name the ERP stores and compares. kind: warehouse, cold or unknown. company: cfpl or cdpl for a cold store (the company whose cold_stocks table holds its rows), else null. grant_code: the code the admin screen grants (auth_user.allowed_warehouses), null when the site cannot be granted. display: the name printed on the delivery challan. address: the challan address, empty when not known. destination: whether pickers offer the site as a transfer To.

'Cold Storage' is the legacy cold From of the old direct form and of IMS: a site of its own, cold in kind, never the same site as any store and never a To. 'Savla Bond' is a cold store of its own, not Savla D-39. Bare 'Savla' is deliberately absent: it does not say which Savla store.
